text: Which of the following is one of the four globally cherished Public Service Values identified in the administrative procedures guide?
explanation: The guide identifies Democratic, Professional, Ethical and People Values.

text: How is remuneration for part-time members of government agency boards described in the guide?

options.text: It is guided by subsisting government circulars
It is set by each board member
It is determined by the Chief Executive Officer

explanation: The guide says remuneration of part-time board members is guided by subsisting government circulars.

text: What is the approved sitting allowance for a member of a Category C agency in the guide?
explanation: The guide lists N55,000 as the approved sitting allowance for a Category C member.

text: What quality are board members expected to bring to the board when they render service to the nation?

options.text: Qualities that have distinguished them in their spheres of service life

explanation: The administrative procedures guide says members should bring the qualities that distinguished them in their spheres of service life.

text: Which expectation of government and the public for public servants is stated in the guide?

options.text: To demonstrate democratic, professional, ethical and people values
To belong to the ruling party
To seek favours for family and friends

explanation: The guide describes democratic, professional, ethical and people values as a public-service expectation.

text: What is a key role of the chairperson in controlling and conducting a board meeting?

options.text: Ensure that appropriate discussion takes place and relevant decisions are made

explanation: The guide describes the chairperson as a facilitator who ensures appropriate discussion and relevant decisions.

text: Which of the following are part-time board members not entitled to solely because of their appointment?
explanation: The guide states that part-time board membership does not entitle members to a permanently allocated official vehicle.

text: Which document is identified as codifying public-service values, ethics and ethos?

options.text: The Companies and Allied Matters Act

explanation: The guide names the Public Service Rules, Financial Regulations and operational guidelines among the documents that codify public-service values and procedures.

text: What is a key responsibility of a board in relation to senior staff?

options.text: Approval of the appointment or promotion of senior staff
Firing all senior staff without procedure

explanation: The guide lists approval of appointment or promotion of senior staff as a board responsibility.

text: Which government office is mentioned as an authority for clarifying grey areas in conflicts between a board or council and a CEO?

options.text: The Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation

explanation: The guide says the Office of the SGF is available for clarification of grey areas in board and CEO relationships.

text: How does the administrative procedures guide describe the relationship between a sector minister and a CEO?

options.text: The minister is the CEO's personal assistant
The CEO provides technical advice to the minister
The minister has no relationship with the CEO
The CEO reports only to private shareholders

explanation: The guide classifies the relationship as including the CEO providing technical advice to the sector minister.

text: What is the maximum number of annual sittings stated in the guide for a board or council?
explanation: The guide references the applicable circular and states that the maximum number of sittings per year is four.

text: When a board member has a conflict of interest, what action does the guide require?

options.text: Disclose the nature of the interest in writing to the board
Ask the CEO to decide privately

explanation: The guide says a member should disclose in writing the nature of a conflict of interest.

text: What should a board member do when a matter concerns their declared conflict of interest?

options.text: Refrain from influencing members and participating in the conflicted decision

explanation: The guide requires a member in conflict to refrain from influencing members through covert or overt means.

text: Which responsibility is reserved for the CEO rather than the board or council?
explanation: The guide lists day-to-day administration of the organisation as a matter reserved for the CEO.

text: What is one of the three classifications of a sector minister's relationship with a board or council?
explanation: The guide lists Ministerial Support, Business Planning and Policy Advice as classifications.

text: What should the chairperson do after the minutes of a meeting have been approved?

options.text: Send the minutes to a political party

explanation: The guide lists signing the minutes after approval as one of the chairperson's functions.

text: What is the role of the secretary during a board meeting when no opinion is requested?

options.text: Vote on behalf of the chairperson

explanation: The guide says the secretary should resist speaking on matters other than procedure unless asked for an opinion.

text: Who holds boards and councils accountable for their performance according to the guide?
explanation: The guide states that sector ministers hold boards and councils accountable for performance.

text: Who was declared the winner of Nigeria's 2023 presidential election in the uploaded current-affairs guide?
explanation: The guide identifies Bola Ahmed Tinubu as the declared winner of the 2023 presidential election.

text: What major economic policy was announced by President Bola Tinubu on inauguration day in May 2023?
explanation: The guide identifies the announcement of fuel-subsidy removal as a major inauguration-day policy.

text: What was the primary aim of the CBN foreign-exchange reform described in the uploaded guide?

options.text: Unifying official and parallel market exchange rates
Pegging the naira permanently to the US dollar

explanation: The guide describes the reform as aimed at unifying official and parallel-market exchange rates.

text: Which Nigerian state was associated with the deadly Christmas Day attacks of December 2023 mentioned in the guide?
explanation: The guide refers to the December 2023 attacks in Plateau State.

text: What significant achievement did Nigeria's women's basketball team, D'Tigress, accomplish in 2025?

options.text: They won their first AfroBasket title
They won their fifth consecutive FIBA Women's AfroBasket title
They qualified for the Olympics for the first time
They won the FIFA Women's World Cup

explanation: The guide says D'Tigress won a fifth consecutive FIBA Women's AfroBasket title in 2025.

text: The March 2024 kidnapping of nearly 400 schoolchildren mentioned in the guide occurred in which state?
explanation: The guide refers to the school kidnapping in Kaduna State.

text: Which major infrastructure project was commissioned to improve Nigeria's refining capacity?
explanation: The guide identifies the Dangote Petroleum Refinery as the major refining-capacity project.

text: What did Nigeria's Electricity Act 2023 allow states to do?

options.text: Fully privatise the entire power sector
Operate and regulate their own electricity markets within the law
Centralise all generation under one federal body

explanation: The guide describes the Act as giving states authority to operate and regulate electricity markets.

text: Who was appointed National Security Adviser by President Tinubu in 2023?
explanation: The uploaded guide identifies Nuhu Ribadu as the NSA appointed in 2023.

text: Who was appointed Chief of Defence Staff when President Tinubu appointed new service chiefs in July 2023?
explanation: The guide identifies Major General Christopher Musa as the Chief of Defence Staff appointed in July 2023.

text: What was the major legal setback faced by Nnamdi Kanu in 2024 according to the uploaded guide?

options.text: The Supreme Court dismissed all charges
The Court of Appeal upheld his acquittal
The Supreme Court overturned a Court of Appeal decision that dismissed the charges

explanation: The guide identifies the Supreme Court's reversal of the Court of Appeal decision as the setback.

text: What hashtag did the guide identify as being used during protests against bad governance in August and September 2024?
explanation: The uploaded current-affairs section identifies #EndBadGovernance.

text: What major reason did the guide give for Nigeria's focus on non-oil growth?

options.text: A decrease in oil production only
The need to diversify the economy and reduce dependence on oil
A new ban on oil exploration
A permanent fall in global oil demand

explanation: The guide links non-oil growth to economic diversification and reduced dependence on oil.

text: Which Nigerian women's football team defended its WAFCON title in 2025, according to the uploaded guide?
explanation: The guide identifies the Super Falcons as the Nigerian team that defended its WAFCON title.

text: Which body began online accreditation for officers on Salary Grade Levels 14, 15 and 16 due for promotion in August 2026?

options.text: The National Board for Technical Education

explanation: The Federal Civil Service Commission announced the online promotion accreditation on 14 August 2026; source: News Agency of Nigeria reports carried by The People's Gazette.

text: What deadline was reported for the 2026 FCSC online promotion accreditation for GL 14–16 officers?
explanation: The reported FCSC accreditation notice directed affected officers to complete the exercise by 28 August 2026.

text: Who was identified as the chairman of the Federal Civil Service Commission in the August 2026 promotion-accreditation report?
explanation: The August 2026 FCSC promotion-accreditation report attributed the announcement to FCSC Chairman Tunji Olaopa.

text: Which Nigerian education initiative was unveiled by the Minister of Education in August 2026 to provide advanced digital skills and certifications?
explanation: Voice of Nigeria reported on 7 August 2026 that the Minister of Education unveiled the National Digital Training Academy.

text: How many verified PTA teachers did the Federal Government approve for recruitment into the Federal Civil Service in August 2026?
explanation: The Federal Ministry of Education report dated 6 August 2026 cited approval to recruit 3,252 verified PTA teachers.

text: Which institution was reported to have granted City University Abuja an operational licence for 2026/2027 admissions?

options.text: The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board
The National Board for Technical Education

explanation: Vanguard reported on 17 August 2026 that the National Universities Commission granted the operational licence.

text: Which school-reentry initiative did UBEC launch in Lagos in August 2026?

options.text: A rehabilitated Alternative High School for Girls

explanation: This was reported by ThisDay on 16 August 2026 as a UBEC effort focused on girls, teenage mothers and learners affected by poverty.

text: Which Nigerian women's football coach was reported dismissed by the NFF on 18 August 2026 after the Super Falcons' World Cup qualification setback?
explanation: Goal reported on 18 August 2026 that the NFF dismissed Super Falcons coach Justine Madugu after the qualification setback.

text: Which court restored the African Democratic Congress and four other parties after an earlier deregistration order, according to 2026 political reports?

options.text: The Customary Court of Appeal only

explanation: BusinessDay reported in 2026 that the Court of Appeal overturned the deregistration order affecting ADC and four other parties.

text: What major political realignment involving Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso was reported ahead of Nigeria's 2027 election?

options.text: They joined the New Democratic Congress
They joined the Nigerian Labour Congress as a political party
They were appointed to the Supreme Court

explanation: BBC reported on 4 May 2026 that Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso joined the New Democratic Congress in a major opposition realignment.
